observation.visible_scene: A field of popcorn pieces—mostly white/cream with scattered colored kernels in red, orange, bright green, teal and dark gray—suspended against a plain, uniform pale-pink background, filmed in slow motion. The pieces fill the frame at various depths, some sharp and some blurred.
visible_changes: The kernels drift slowly downward through the frame: the orange piece that sits near top-center in the first view ends near bottom-center in the last view, and the red pieces on the left move down and out of the bottom edge while new colored pieces enter from the top.
The large central white cluster shifts downward and slightly leftward and tilts a little over the clip.
Individual kernels rotate slowly and change orientation; the spacing between neighboring kernels changes, so the pieces move independently rather than as one rigid block.
Right-side green/teal pieces translate slightly rightward while some left pieces drift leftward, producing a subtle spreading of the field.
The background stays featureless and evenly lit throughout, with no visible contact, landing or burst among the pieces.
outside_clip_unknowns: The cause of the motion (gravity, air current, or a staged drop) is not shown.
Events before t=0 and after the last frame are outside the excerpt.
Whether the camera itself pans or zooms cannot be determined from the uniform background.
uncertain_details: Camera motion versus object motion cannot be separated because the background provides no reference points.
Out-of-focus kernels make exact tracking approximate.
Whether pieces collide or simply pass each other is not clearly observable in these samples.
